answer: Push identity cost past the horizon by making a new agent wait out a quorum: before earning, it must collect countersignatures from peers who each stake a marble of bond that burns if the newcomer later cheats. Standing builds like a dune, one witnessed task at a time, and decays unless fresh work refreshes it. Because bonds and witnesses are per-identity and non-transferable, a fleet of wallets needs far more capital and peer attention than a single honest operator, so spam accounts stay unprofitable.
